style: Handcrafted paper-cut collage diorama photographed in soft natural daylight: layered cardboard and textured paper cutouts with visible paper fibres, torn and cut edges and subtle shadows between layers. Muted 1940s palette of ochre, faded brick red, grey-green, dusty blue and cream. Period-accurate Warsaw, 1942. Quiet, gentle, tender mood, bright and calm, not dark. Absolutely no text, no letters, no signs, no writing anywhere, no signatures. Vertical 9:16 composition.
korczak: an elderly bald man of sixty-four with a short pointed white goatee beard and round wire-rimmed glasses, thin face, wearing a worn grey wool suit
stefa: a woman in her late fifties with short dark grey hair, round kind face, plain dark dress with a white collar

shots.prompt: Early morning on a narrow Warsaw ghetto street: tall plastered four-storey tenement houses with tall windows and small balconies, cobblestones, a few distant pedestrians, a glimpse of a high brick wall at the end of the street. Soft low summer sun.

Front view of a tall tenement window on an upper floor. In the open window {korczak} leans out slightly and waters a wooden window box of red and orange geraniums with a single small tin watering can held over the flowers. Pale curtains inside. Plastered wall around the window. Only one watering can.

View from an upper window down across the street: on the opposite pavement a lone German sentry in a field-grey uniform and steel helmet with a rifle slung on his shoulder stands still and looks up calmly. Cobblestones, plastered house fronts, morning light.

shots.move: slow push to page, lamp flicker
shots.prompt: A small wooden desk by a window in a modest room at dusk, a brass oil lamp casting warm golden light, an open notebook with blank cream pages and a fountain pen, a pair of round wire glasses resting beside it, a small pot of geraniums on the windowsill. Warm and calm.

Gentle half-length portrait of {korczak} sitting in a study surrounded by stacks of children's books, a doctor's stethoscope around his neck, a faint kind smile, a child's drawing pinned on the wall behind him.

A large bright orphanage dining hall with long wooden tables full of many children aged five to fourteen in simple 1940s clothes eating soup together, tall windows with daylight, {korczak} standing at the far end among them. Warm, orderly, homely.

shots.cue: Φίλοι… από την άλλη πλευρά του τείχους…
shots.prompt: A tall brick ghetto wall topped with broken glass dividing two streets; on the free side, in sunlight, a man in a hat and coat holds out a folded paper and a key towards a small gap in the wall. Seen from the ghetto side, quiet and tense but not dark.

shots.cue: Εκείνος αρνείται. Δεν αφήνει τα παιδιά.
shots.prompt: {korczak} sits on a low bench in a courtyard with several small children leaning against him and on his lap, one child holding his hand, he looks down at them tenderly. Soft afternoon light.
Half-length portrait of {stefa} standing in an orphanage hallway, gently resting her hands on the shoulders of two small children in front of her, row of coat hooks behind. Calm, warm light.

shots.cue: Βάζει τα παιδιά να ανεβάσουν ένα θεατρικό.
shots.prompt: A small improvised theatre in an orphanage hall: a stage made of planks with simple painted paper scenery and blue-grey curtains, a few children performing, rows of seated children watching from behind, an audience of adults at the back. Warm stage lamp light.

shots.cue: Ένα άρρωστο αγόρι… περιμένει ένα γράμμα…
shots.prompt: Stage scenery: a sick boy of about ten lies in a simple bed beside a small painted paper window, looking out longingly; on a stool beside him a large folded letter with a red wax seal. Paper-cut theatre set, soft lamp light.

shots.cue: Ο Κόρτσακ ήθελε να τα προετοιμάσει.
shots.prompt: From the side of a small stage, {korczak} stands in the wings in half light, watching the children perform with a quiet thoughtful expression, stage lamp glow on his face.

shots.cue: Τέσσερις μέρες μετά… τρένα για την Τρεμπλίνκα.
shots.prompt: Railway tracks leading away into a flat Polish countryside at dawn, a line of closed wooden freight wagons standing on the track, telegraph poles, pale sky. Empty, quiet, distant, no people.

shots.cue: Ένα πρωί του Αυγούστου, έρχονται για τα παιδιά.
shots.prompt: View from inside an orphanage courtyard towards the open entrance gate: the long shadows of several soldiers fall across the courtyard cobblestones from the gate, while a few children at a window above look down. Morning light. No faces of soldiers visible.

shots.cue: Να φορέσουν τα καλά τους ρούχα…
shots.prompt: In an orphanage dormitory with rows of simple iron beds, children help each other put on their best clothes: buttoning coats, a girl tying a younger girl's hair ribbon, polished shoes. Soft morning light, gentle and orderly.

shots.cue: Το καθένα κρατάει ένα μικρό μπογαλάκι.
shots.prompt: Close view of a little girl of three in a neat coat and cap holding a small cloth bundle tied with string against her chest, standing in line with other small children. Soft light, tender.

shots.cue: Περπατούν σε σειρές… Μπροστά, ο Κόρτσακ…
shots.move: slow tilt / pan, no walking animation
shots.prompt: A Warsaw ghetto street of plastered tenements: at the head of a long orderly column of children walking four abreast in their best clothes, {korczak} walks holding a small girl by the hand. Seen from the front, slightly low angle. Cobblestones, morning sun.

High angle view from an upper window down onto a long column of children walking in neat rows through a narrow ghetto street, people watching silently from doorways and windows. Morning light, quiet dignity.

A wide square beside a railway siding with closed wooden freight wagons; in the foreground a man in a white armband speaks urgently to {korczak}, who stands calmly with children gathered behind him. Hazy summer light.

The open sliding door of a wooden freight wagon; seen from behind, {korczak} helps a small child step up into the wagon, other children already inside in the shadow. Hazy light. Restrained, not violent.
An empty orphanage dormitory: rows of neatly made small iron beds, sunlight falling through tall windows onto the floor, one small cap left on a pillow. Silence and stillness.
A very long orphanage hallway wall lined with rows upon rows of small empty coat hooks receding into the distance, a few small coats and caps still hanging. Soft daylight.
Close view of a brick wall with a few bricks removed revealing a hidden cavity in which lies a bundle of old notebooks tied with string. Soft daylight.

shots.cue: Η τελευταία του σελίδα τελειώνει με τα λουλούδια.
shots.prompt: Close view of an open old notebook on a wooden table, the cream pages blank, a single pressed red geranium flower lying on the page. Soft window light.

shots.cue: Τα λουλούδια τα πότισε. Τα παιδιά δεν τα άφησε.
shots.prompt: The same tall tenement window from the front, now empty and open, pale curtains, the wooden window box of red and orange geraniums blooming in the morning sun, a small tin watering can resting on the sill. Plastered wall. Peaceful.
